description: Check how the Model Access rules of the connected project's workspace decide one model for one run: rule by rule (the whole wallet's, the member's, the API key's, the surface's and the agent's), why each decides as it does (the model's own entry, one of its categories, or what the rule does with every model it does not name), and the refusal text a run would get (error code 92). Nothing runs and nothing is charged. With no member, project, surface or agent it checks a run through this connection. A way in that comes with an API key (api, mcp, llm-gateway, extension) is checked with this connection's key unless project names another, and a run with a key counts as the person who created that key. When the model is blocked and this connection can change the rules, nextAction is the change summary that would allow it in the first rule that blocks it.

agent.description: A deployed agent, by name or guid: checks a run the agent starts (surface agent).

member.description: Team only: the team member whose run to check, by e-mail or user id. Left out, the person who created the connected project. A run with an API key counts as the person who created the key, so with project or agent that person is checked.

model.description: The model, by owner/slug as search_models shows it, or by its id.

project.description: The API key the run uses, by its project id or exact name. Left out, this connection's own key when nothing else is named, or when surface is api, mcp, llm-gateway or extension and no member is named.

surface.description: The way in: web (the dashboard), api (an API key, a local install of this server included), mcp (the hosted MCP server), llm-gateway, extension or agent. Left out, the surface this connection counts as when nothing else is named, api with a project, and web for a member.

name: check_model_access

canManage.description: Whether this connection can change the rules.

context.description: The run Wiro checked. A run with an API key counts as the person who created the key.

keyLeftOut.description: True when the run comes in with an API key the call did not name, so that key's own rule is not part of this check.

thisConnection.description: True for a run through this connection.

fixes.description: For each rule that blocks the model, the change summary that would allow it there. Every one must change for the model to run.

message.description: The refusal text a run would get, with error code 92; null when it is allowed.

model.description: The model's owner/slug, as Wiro names it.

rules.description: Every rule that applies to this run, widest first.

by.description: What in the rule decides: the model's own entry, one of its categories, or what the rule gives every model it does not name.

updatedBy.description: Who changed it last. Absent when Wiro did not say, or when a change Wiro made itself was the last.

name.description: Their name or e-mail, or "the organization owner"; absent for someone who is no longer in the team.

title: Check whether Wiro Model Access rules allow a model
